landing.hero_desc: Baaqoon Educational Platform, your secure digital space for Tawjihi students. We combine technology and willpower to create excellence.
landing.sketch_caption: Sketch: The Olive Tree and Roots of Knowledge
landing.mission_text: The 'Baaqoon' project was launched in response to the exceptional circumstances faced by students in Palestine. We strive to bridge the educational gap and provide a stable digital environment to ensure the continuation of the educational journey.
landing.care_text: Continuous academic and psychological support to ensure student excellence.
landing.platform_text: Strong digital infrastructure ensuring privacy and continuous service.
landing.hierarchy_desc: Distributed institutional management to ensure the highest quality in monitoring and teaching.
landing.h_admin_desc: General supervision, strategic decision-making, and approval of supervisors and plans.
landing.h_supervisor_desc: Monitoring curriculum progress, communicating with teachers, and tracking daily attendance.
landing.h_teacher_desc: An elite group of teachers delivering interactive classes, monitoring attendance, and evaluating students.
